## TRA Timeline

#### Up-C IPO registration

- 2010-08-10: Original S-1 filed for the Up-C IPO
- 2010-10-15: S-1/A Amendment No. 1 first attaches the form-of TRA as Exhibit 10.4
- 2010-11-17: S-1/A Amendment No. 2 re-files the form-of TRA with affiliated entities redomiciled from Quebec to Delaware

#### Registration withdrawal

- 2011-09-30: Form RW (Registration Withdrawal) filed; IPO never closed and the TRA never executed

## Explanation

Aveon Group L.P. registered an Up-C IPO in August 2010 contemplating a Tax Receivable Agreement between Aveon Holdings I GP Inc. (the Corporate Taxpayer) and the Aveon Holdings I Limited Partners, paying 85% of cash tax savings from Section 743(b) and 734(b) basis step-ups on Partnership-Unit exchanges plus imputed-interest deductions (with a 70% lump-sum substitute on a Change in Tax Law). The form-of TRA was filed as Exhibit 10.4 to S-1/A Amendments Nos. 1 and 2 with blank preamble date and unsigned signature pages. The Registration Statement was never declared effective; Aveon withdrew the registration on September 30, 2011, and the contract was never executed. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record.
